data.name: Tidewood
data.detailed_description:
Tidewood is an open-world crafting survival game taking place across the endless world of oceans, islands, continents, and biomes. Begin from scratch, gather everything you can find and craft a new life either on dry land or out at sea.

Collect sticks, stones, wood, ore, and many other natural resources to craft useful tools, weapons, equipment, and building materials. Start from basic stone tools, but later craft more advanced equipment as you travel farther and find better resources.

SURVIVE ON LAND AND AT SEA

Pay attention to your hunger and thirst during your quest for food, fresh water, and materials. Fish, farm, swim, and explore the world, but always be careful as sharks swim below the water and some other hostile creatures appear at night.

BUILD YOUR WAY

Build a home on dry land or a floating base on water. Start from a small raft, but gradually craft additional floors, walls, roof, crafting stations, and all other necessary equipment for survival.

Whether it is going to be a peaceful coastal village, a big land settlement, or a mobile home, the choice is yours.

CRAFT AND UPGRADE

Create useful survival equipment from gathered resources. Create axes to chop trees, pickaxes to break stones and ores, bows to protect yourself, building hammers to construct buildings, and other improved metal tools to make gathering easier and faster.

EXPLORE AN ENDLESS WORLD

Travel across a procedurally generated world full of endless oceans, big landmasses, various environments, wildlife, resources, and hazards. Every trip will offer something new to discover including new areas to build houses, new materials to gather, and new things to survive.

FACE THE DANGERS OF THE WILD

World changes when the sun sets. Protect yourself from hostile creatures, defend yourself against enemies both on land and underwater, and be prepared for danger when exploring unknown places.

PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

Survive alone or collaborate with your friends. Gather resources, explore new lands, fight hostile creatures, and build a settlement with your friends.

KEY FEATURES

Explore an endless procedurally generated world

Travel across oceans, islands, continents, and biomes

Upgrade from stone to metal tools while gathering resources

Build expandable bases both on land and water

Craft weapons, tools, equipment, and survival items

Fish, farm, swim, and find food and fresh water

Fight hostile creatures both underwater and at night

Survive alone or play with friends

Gather. Craft. Build. Survive. Explore Tidewood.
